headline: Nvidia forms open AI-security alliance; Kimi K3 weights released
body: Two stories tilted the day toward the brighter endings. Nvidia launched the Open Secure AI Alliance, a 30-plus member group including Microsoft, IBM and Hugging Face, to build open AI cybersecurity tools after the OpenAI breach; OpenAI, Google and Anthropic were absent. That is a modest boost to Alignment & Control, which helps Protector God and Gatekeeper and pulls Conquerors back. Moonshot also published the full Kimi K3 weights under a modified MIT license, letting anyone self-host a near-frontier model. Spreading capability widely reduces Power Concentration, which helps Libertarian Utopia and Egalitarian Utopia and trims 1984 and Benevolent Dictator. Horizon Balance recovered to -1.30.
movers_note: Libertarian Utopia +0.2 came from the Nvidia alliance (+0.12) and the Kimi K3 weights (+0.09); Protector God +0.2 came mainly from the alliance (+0.17); Egalitarian Utopia +0.2 split +0.12/+0.06 between them.
